headline: 900 snakes from farm washed away by flood, sparking local panic
summary: A massive flood has caused a snake farm to be inundated, releasing hundreds of snakes into the surrounding areas. Residents are now living in fear of encountering these reptiles.
details: A catastrophic flood has led to the inundation of a snake farm, resulting in the escape of approximately 900 snakes. This incident has caused widespread panic among local residents.

The sheer number of snakes now loose in the environment raises significant concerns for public safety. Authorities are likely to be on high alert to manage the situation and ensure community well-being.

While the specific types of snakes and the exact location of the farm are not detailed, the event underscores the unpredictable dangers that can arise during natural disasters, particularly in flood-prone regions.

headline: Continuous rain: Khowai River dam breaks, flooding 20 villages in Habiganj
summary: The breach occurred in the Charhamuya Kaliganj area, submerging thousands of acres of cropland and forcing many residents to seek refuge on higher ground.
details: Continuous heavy rain and upstream hill water have caused the Khowai River dam to break, leading to the flooding of at least 20 villages in Habiganj. The breach occurred on Thursday night (July 9) in the Charhamuya Kaliganj area of Sadar Upazila, inundating a vast expanse of land.

Thousands of acres of agricultural land have been submerged due to this incident. Many residents, caught by the sudden flood, have been forced to seek shelter on elevated roads or embankments as their homes became inundated.

The Water Development Board reported that the exact extent of the dam breach could not be determined in the darkness of night. Consequently, immediate repair work was not possible. Efforts to repair the dam are expected to commence on Friday morning (July 10), pending an assessment of the situation.
